summary: Unlinks a resource node a1 from its doubly-linked list unconditionally, then, when a1 is non-null, runs a resource-specific cleanup handler and frees the node. Returns 0. Used by six cleanup paths across collision, audio, and resource subsystems.

Run the resource-specific cleanup/release handler ConditionalResourceCleanup_3310 on a1.
Free the node allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
